notes.title: [LIVE] Dead Dynamite DLC + Update
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

You will notice there is a new “Dead Dynamite” DLC available as well as an update. Let us hint you a little without giving away too much.

https://youtu.be/rrOKJHYjcqw

This DLC is a brand new campaign, where you will meet … er, somebody who will teach you how to craft… ahem, explosive things.
You can help her go deep into… somewhere to get rid of the zombie infection once and for all.

This DLC includes:
•	A new NPC.
•	A new campaign with fresh new raids.
•	A new raid objective: destruction
•	3 New enemies
•	A new boss!
•	New living animals: rats + linked recipes.
•	An entirely new environment: the old (spoiler) and underground (spoiler too).
•	New weapon type: things that explode.
•	1 Double Speed weapon (I personally love this one).
•	1 Melee Weapon.
•	1 New projectile weapon (you asked for it).
•	1 New armor set.
•	A new explosive trap weapon.
•	Destructible and explosive props (Crates, rocks, gas tanks, etc.)

The base game will be updated so owners of this new DLC can invite other players to adventure with them without having to purchase it.
•	Any player that doesn’t own the DLC can join missions launched by DLC owners (in private and public camp)
•	All new explosive items can be gathered, equipped and used by non-DLC owners.
•	All users will get a new recipe: baits. 

Dead Dynamite DLC is now available and you can get it now with a 30% off discount!
Stay safe!



Doctor Nuclearo.

notes.title: Game Release and Server Reset Information
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

    First, we'd like to thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your participation on this Early Access journey with us. Through blood, sweat and tears -- well, zombie blood anyway -- we have created a sequel to How to Survive 1 that brings you out of the islands into New Orleans with more Kovac shenanigans. Although we had a few bumps in the road (but who doesn't) through your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports we feel we have created a game you will be excited to play.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=759766146

   Second, release is tomorrow morning at 6am PST, 1pm GMT. All servers will be down for maintenance from 4am-6am PST, 11am-1pm GMT. Please note that due to a comprehensive overhaul of the save game structure, we are completely wiping servers beforehand. This wipe will remove everything from the server including your camp, your experience and your character. Old camp and character saves will not be compatible. When the servers come back online tomorrow, you will notice the new save structure by enjoying one character that can join any camp, local or online, public or private. There will be 4 character slots available and up to 5 online camps. You may also change your camp from public to private and conversely. Also, all characters will generate a backup locally on your machine.

    Last, please continue to post comments, feedback, suggestions and bug reports on our forums as we will be monitoring them and game performance to decide our next steps. So stay tuned!

    EKO Software & 505 Games

notes.title: [LIVE] August 22 - More Language Support & Release Date
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

When we began Early Access back in 2015 we stated that we wanted to have a final game by summer 2016. And we can now announce that we will be launching How to Survive 2 on September 8th 2016.

For the past few months, we have been working with you to enhance, widen and shape How to Survive 2 by taking in account requests and suggestions from the forums. We would like to thank everyone for their feedback by making sure that you get a nice pack of Early Access items. So anyone who purchased the game before official launch will receive the Pet Crow, the Winter Hat and the Dual Knives. Those who purchase at launch and after will need to purchase them via DLC. We will be keeping the Primal Fear Armor for those who already own another How to Survive franchise game. The Voodoo Guitar will remain exclusive to players who purchased the game early (thank you, guys!). 

We knew from our research that the community wanted a space where they could play with friends and freely create their own camps, so we focused in developing a system where you could invite other players and cooperate with them to survive.

The scenarios are now bigger than ever in the How to Survive franchise, introducing a variety of environments from swamps to suburban streets, sewers, farms, the French Quarter, etc. And we have populated it with infected hordes that include classic zombies, fast zombies, SWAT, exploding or mutilated zombies, farmers and more. You can also find a large catalogue of animals, infected or not, roaming the scenarios: alligators, turtles, pelicans, bears, deer, pigs, bunnies, etc.

You can come across over a dozen NPCs that will trigger dozens of quests with different mechanics: scavenge, timed challenges, escort and stealth missions. And, first among the locals, there is Kovac who will guide your steps to craft your gear, build your camp and fortify it. Following his recipes, you and your friends will be able to equip your survivors with amazing weapons and armors. And you can choose among dozens of skills to level up and create unique characters. 

There has been exhaustive work tweaking and adjusting animations, controls, difficulty, leveling, etc. And, by the time that you read these lines, our plan is to have the game available into, at least, 11 languages! In our latest update today we have added language support for Korean, Thai and Turkish. 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=749664916

There will be one last content update at launch to bring new challenges and quests, camp modifications, new enemies, building, weapon and armor novelties and… a special surprise Kovac finale! We wanted to do something completely crazy and unexpected, just like Kovac. So don’t tell us… "Oh, I saw that coming…" because you didn’t. ;)

Upon game launch we will need to reset the servers which will mean all camps and characters will be reset back to the beginning.  We have implemented a new save structure that is a bit more simplified than what we had during Early Access which we hope will clear up a number of issues that users have reported to us.  Along with the save update we are also releasing all the game Achievements for the game which will require you to start from a fresh launch.  The quest structure has been updated and finalized so we hope everyone will have a nice story quest flow that will lead up to our new ultra-exciting story ending.

After the game launch we will be monitoring the forums and game performance to decide our next steps. So stay tuned!

EKO Software & 505 Games

Free a horde of special infected? (To take good care of your survivor.) - 60 sec to vote with #yes or #no to trigger a wave of 3 special zombies 
Who wants to become a nasty zombie? - (Type the magic word to have a chance to attack the player!) - 60 sec to say #me then 2 zombies randomly named by the voters will come to attack

Health or damage boost? (Choose how to help your survivor! You may even get a thank-you!) - 60 sec to vote with #heal or #damage to heal or activate a damage buff to the player
Speed or stamina? (There are two types of runners!) - 60 sec to vote with #speed or #stamina to activate a speed or stamina potion to the player
Too many choices! (Don't be afraid to choose!) - 60 sec to vote #speed or #stamina or #heal or #damage

notes.title: Live Update March 14 - It's a Biggie!
notes.notes:
The live update today consists of the following testing dates and is now live on all branches. Please let us know if you experience any issues so that we may address them.

Update Friday (March, the 4th)

Level of the camp,  can be extended up to 35, if you successfully complete...
dun dun dun...the Kovac's challenges! Protect your camp and resist the incoming hordes of zombies to deserve your level cap extension! A new building can be crafted from the camp's interface: the Pylon, from which you can trigger the Kovac's challenges
Weight Management is now active! 
When you craft something from a building or the camp, the resources are now directly taken from the trunks 
 The objects crafted from the buildings don't take time anymore to be crafted and they are directly dropped into your backpack when they are finished
3 different types of traps can be crafted to protect your camp
carpet of spikes, jazzy attractor and rotating blades(don't stand too close!!!)
 
 Barricades can be repaired and upgraded to be more resistant
Players can stay in last stand using their gun even if they don't have a revive potion
Added 6 new missions given by Kovac, Kenji, the red necks, or the fans 
New type of quest added: the "elite" quests. You die, you leave. Simple. Efficient.
Added an icon on player's inventory to spot equipped items.
More info are displayed when you highlight a quest of the quests givers (rewards, levels, etc.)
Added a whole new armor set to craft. The "Leviathan" armor set! Brrr!
Added 6 new weapons to craft:
handcrafted knives
compound bow
handgun, revolver, rifle and machine gun (5th generation)
Added new modules to boost your weapons:
scope for your bows
fast scope for crossbows and firearms
more accurate scope for crossbows and firearms
improved suppressor for firearms
concentrator for firearms (what is that?)
clip extension for all firearms
reinforcements to strike harder with your firearms
auto-fire module to turn your handgun into a full auto SMG (or something like that)
stabilizer for your bows
Added new recipes and materials to craft all these new objects  
Added new recipes to craft better backpacks with higher capacity
Added pointed ammunition for firearms...for those who like the zombies skewers.
New friends of Kovac live in his bunker now. Don't feed them!!! Seriously, just don't.
Now, special items such as security keys are not kept when you leave their raid 
Various adjustments of zombies' perforation and stopping power levels
You can delete the useless profiles you created by playing in local coop  
Cleaner transition between characters when selecting online games
Online : fixed spawn zombies at wrong position
Online : fixed zombies not playing attack animations
Fixed missing sound when shooting in last stand
Removed double cursor in menus when playing with option "double controls" is enabled
When first player has keyboard controls set in controls menu, the second player can now spawn with paddle1
Fixed bug when player could upgrade camp & character one step beyond the limit 
Fixed last stand not displayed correctly in online
Fixed missing fire sound in last stand
Fixed various collision or nav mesh issues in the camp and in the raids 
Fixed loot issue in Kenji's quest "Strength in unity"

And lastly, meet Edgar Allan Crow:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=637805286 You will find him located in your Private Trunk in the Bunker.

Edit:
Update March 7

Some missing icons of recipes have been updated
The durability of fences and traps has been better balanced 
The weight of some objects has been adjusted, too (i.e. silver / 10mm ammo, coins, aluminum cans, etc.) according to the feedback of the community. Thank you for that!   

Edit 2:

notes.title: Now Live Update February 19 - Public Camps, Trading and Chat
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors, 

As usual, thank you for all your feedback!   

The update is now available on all branches.

You can now create public camps!!! 
                
                Public camps are accessible to everyone and can be created / selected from your camp selection screen.
                When joining a public camp, you control an avatar that is the same in all public camps.
                When you create a public camp, you can choose the default grade of your visitors, the maximum number of players that can play simultaneously on the camp and the % of friendly fire damage.
                
New membership management tool has been added. 
                
                From "guest" to "member" or even "associate", promote your teammates to give them more administration rights on your camp.
                Added the option to banish players from your public camp. 
                
A "private chest" has been added in the Kovac's bunker, allowing you to recover the non-exchangeable special objects that you have destroyed.
                
                This means you can now destroy them, in preparation of the next game update including the weight management ^_^ (hint hint, clean your backpacks out now!)
                
Trading to other players has been added.
Your trade partner must be within 10 meters to trade to.

A chat interface has been added to send predefined messages / emoticons to your teammates!
                
                The chat interface replaces the flashlight's switching button / key (By default Alt / Rb button.)
                Hold the chat button to open the chat, select the sentence / emoticon among the multiple thematic wheels available and release the button to send your message.
                You can change your audience target to talk to the players in your raid, on the camp or both of them. 
                
The flashlight is now an inventory object.
                
                A flashlight is automatically added to your backpack when you create a new character.
                Already existing survivors will find the flashlight in their private chest, in Kovac's bunker. Don't forget it as it gets dark and dangerous out there at night!
                The flashlight can be switched on / off by selecting its icon in the quick inventory and activate / deactivate it. 
                
Prices and required levels of character's skills have been increased to bring more strategy to the game.
When you open a chest, a "Transfer everything" button has been added to give you the possibility to drop all the content of the current tab of your inventory to this chest.
The map of Kovac's bunker is now visible.
Notifications have been added when a building or a barricade is attacked.
Barricades can be repaired and upgraded now!
The weapons customization interface (aka "modules interface") has been improved to display the good stats and to give you the option to rotate the 3d model.
The craft bug button MAKE when using a mouse has been fixed.


If you experience any crash, please send the proc.dmp file to support@ekosystem.com 

Next major update should come fast! Stay tuned!  And as usual, you can chat more about the update with devs and other players here on this forum post: http://steamcommunity.com/app/360170/discussions/0/412447613565528422/

Take care : )

Dear Survivors, 

Thank you for all your great feedback this past week!  We have been able to address the 29 issues below in this week's Beta branch update.

To access it just go in BETAS tab of game properties and select the beta_branch

Update for this friday (November 6) - Beta_branch

- With Keyboard/Mouse controls, melee attacks now target cursor position
- Attacking a target on stairs with melee weapon fixed
- Attacking a target with melee attack of a ranged weapon fixed
- Crash removed when viewing 3D model of wooden stick in inventory.
- Pathfinding for zombie improved, Zombies should be able to climb on cars more frequently
- Various improvements in online multiplayer code to prevent deconnections / bugs
- Addition of message box to display some network error
- With paddle control, shooting a far small target with distant weapons now correctly hit the target
- Items being crafted are no longer displayed in the quick inventory
- Hunger gauge decreases slower than thirst gauge, now, as in real life!
- New 3D model for some plants to collect (instead of generic box)
- New 3D Model for candies and chips (instead of generic box)
- Damage of the baseball bat slightly improved
- Damage and health of infected deer have been reduced
- 6th quest of Kovac now requires to kill 5 deers instead of 8
- Drop rate of chocolate bars from zombies have been reduced
- Fire rate of advanced ranged weapons have been increased
- Melee damage of advanced ranged weapons have been increased
- Buildings upgrade now works as intended in multiplayer mode (upgradable to camp level)
- Resources to upgrade building have been reduced
- Sprinting zombies can be stopped more efficiently by using weapons with high stopping power, and don't perform attacks too fast anymore
- Stopping power and perforation values of arrows more balanced
- Kitchen's recipes have been updated
- Damage of pelican's slime decreased
- Camp's collision updated to tap various holes
- Recipe of black glasses removed (useless for now)
- Zombies can drop lead-made bracelets (useful resource to create bullets)
- More resources of "stone" are available in the town environment
- Hammer, screwdriver, wrench, lime and cutting plier are no more randomized and have fixed position to discover

This list may not be fully exhaustive, but reflects most of the changes.





Other features in production (not in November 6 beta_branch update) :

- Menu to customize keys for keyboard and mouse controls (most likely in next week update)
- Possibility to split stack of objects when moving them from/to player inventory to/from trunk inventory (most likely in next week update)
- Menu for options including sound and music volume and various other options (delivery date will provided later)
- Playable female character (delivery date will provided later)

A full list of all modifications will be provided later for the next update.

Take care !

notes.title: Hotfix notes - November 2nd
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

Just in case you didn't have the opportunity to read EKO's message here is the list of hotfixes implemented this week.

- the key 'J' has been added to access the quest validation menu as some player experienced problems to access this menu (the 'J' has been added in addtion to the existing key),
- the scroll issue to access last Kovac quest has been fixed,
- a protection has been added to prevent loss of character progression (locally saved). After a network problem, you can still experience character reset to level 1, but it will not be saved. If you disconnect and reconnect, you character will get his progression back,
- a protection has been added to prevent loss of camp progression (cloud saved). After a network problem, you can still experience a reset of the camp, but it will not be saved. If you disconnect and reconnect, you camp will be back.
- a bug in the inventory of the trunk has been removed and your teammates should be able to pick up all objects in the trunk.

It's a first hotfix, another update will come quickly with new bug fixes and improvements.

Thank you for all your feedbacks, we are currently reading, sorting and iscussing them in order to set up the action plan.

We'll come back soon with a schedule to describe when you will get some of the requested features (female character, remap keys menu, option menu, customization menu, ...).

Thanks again for your support and don't forget you can give us feedback on the specic threads!

Take care !
